verdict.rationale: Windmill's workflows-as-code support loops, and the platform itself handles parallelism and checkpointing, so iterating an operation across many items is a native engine capability. Separately, the AI-assisted Compare & Deploy page opens with multiple edited items preselected for deployment together. Both are thin, indirect mentions, and no dedicated bulk-action feature is documented. Missing for 10: explicit documented bulk/for-each-over-items operations, bulk management actions on scripts/flows/jobs, limits/scale details, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: using familiar language constructs like functions, conditionals, and loops, while Windmill handles checkpointing, parallelism, and fault tolerance
it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy
